purpose: Reproducible feedback analysis and historical operational-demand forecasting, consumed by source-backed evaluation reports and actual JSON inference. No current-market, CPA accuracy or deployment claim.
cost: Existing local execution only; no paid API, model or dependency download

sources.creator: Hadi Fanaee-T
sources.scope: Historic 2011-2012 Capital Bikeshare aggregate demand; not contemporary business accuracy

sources.creator: Brian Keith
sources.scope: Human-annotated Spanish/English paper-review orientation; not Codex-issue human labels

forecast.reporting_delay_assumption: Each observed day's aggregate is available at local midnight two calendar dates later; a declared conservative scenario, not observed source publication metadata
features: mean of seven counts through lag2
forecast.selection: Lowest aggregate MAE on two walk-forward tuning folds only; ties by fixed route/alpha order

calibration.method: 90th percentile absolute residual interval; empirical coverage measured separately, no universal guarantee

forecast.cold_start: Abstain with explicit missing-history or outside-validated-period reason; never silently fill future observations

review_classification.target: orientation -2..2, systematic annotation of perceived review polarity
review_classification.grouping: Paper ID; merge groups sharing identical normalized text before deterministic hash split
review_classification.splits: Stable group hash buckets 0..59 train,60..79 validation,80..99 test; all rows retained or explicitly quarantined
review_classification.candidate: Training-only vocabulary multinomial naive Bayes; word or word+character-trigram features and alpha0.5 or1 selected only on validation macro-F1 then MAE
review_classification.subgroups: Actual Spanish/English counts and errors; small English group cannot establish general English performance
review_classification.interpretation: Human source annotations are subjective perceived polarity, distinct from the original reviewer's evaluation. Existing independent-AI Codex-issue labels remain a different evidence type.

clustering.method: TF-IDF cosine neighborhoods with declared thresholds0.18/0.25/0.32, noise and author weighting; no population trend inferred from26hours
clustering.consumer: Evidence-linked operational needs and source-coverage warning

CPA: Exercise real guard and undefined/zero-conversion handling, but representative campaign/account feature and outcome data remain absent. No predictive CPA accuracy claim.
ADAPTATION: No classifier-as-LoRA or CPU proxy claim. Exact open-model adaptation is a separately scoped root-owned operation.
